d.ko: Join thousands of players in a true sandbox MMORPG where every action shapes a living, player-driven world. Master long-term professions at your own pace, unlock mounts and boats, and grow your settlement into a cozy homestead or thriving metropolis. Grind solo, build together, or play passively.
d.en: Join thousands of players in a true sandbox MMORPG where every action shapes a living, player-driven world. Master long-term professions at your own pace, unlock mounts and boats, and grow your settlement into a cozy homestead or thriving metropolis. Grind solo, build together, or play passively.
d.zh: 与成千上万名玩家一起，走进真正的沙盒MMORPG。你的每一次行动，都在塑造这个由玩家主导的鲜活世界。按自己的节奏钻研职业，解锁坐骑和船只，将定居点发展成温馨的家园或繁华的大都市。独自埋头苦干、与伙伴携手建造，或是轻松挂机，玩法由你决定。
